answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and linking equivocation evidence across identities: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, their correlated penalty grows as O(k^2), while detecting a managed swarm applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss through escrow slashing and asymmetric depreciation. Thus splitting stake among cedar, karst, or yarrow-named identities cannot dilute risk; coordination increases expected loss faster than control capacity.
